visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown, middle-parted hair, wearing a red undershirt and a blue-and-grey color-blocked jacket, stands in a dimly lit indoor space. He speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures. Behind him, a large model of a creature and various exhibition items are visible but out of focus. (2) The camera cuts to a wider shot where the man is standing next to a life-sized model of a character in a blue, textured suit wearing a mask and goggles, holding a long rifle. The background consists of industrial-style white walls and other exhibition displays. (3) A montage follows, showing close-up shots of intricately detailed models: a skeletal, moss-covered figure known as a Giant Warrior, and a brown, winged insectoid creature. The lighting is focused on the objects, creating deep shadows. (4) The scene shifts to a wall covered in numerous vintage anime magazine covers and posters. The man is seen walking past them and later sitting inside a large, yellow, furry interior that resembles a bus with windows. (5) The final phase shows the man standing in front of a large, framed poster with a character and a large grey creature. He looks back at the camera and smiles. The video ends with a shot of the exhibition entrance, a white structure with colorful text overlays and a ticket booth.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你知道嗎是先做出了《風之谷》. (2) [Subtitle]: 吉卜力工作室才成立的喔. (3) [Subtitle]: 王蟲眼睛從藍轉紅的每一幕. (4) [Subtitle]: 都是上百張原畫的堆疊. (5) [Subtitle]: 娜烏西卡. (6) [Subtitle]: (企劃) 真的嗎. (7) [Subtitle]: 真的啦你看. (8) [Subtitle]: 喜歡《風之谷》《龍貓》《天空之城》等吉卜力作品的大家. (9) [Subtitle]: 「Animage 雜誌和吉卜力展」大家一定要來看看喔. (10) [Subtitle]: 這座模型呢是藝術家竹谷隆之想像娜烏西卡深入腐海的時候的. (11) [Subtitle]: 這個穿著來設計的. (12) [Subtitle]: 腐海裡面有非常非常多的黴菌跟菌絲. (13) [Subtitle]: 所以其實是菌絲來呈現在這個上面. (14) [Subtitle]: 這個是腐朽的巨神兵. (15) [Subtitle]: 也是竹谷隆之做的. (16) [Subtitle]: 那個時候這一隻一直不出 (模型). (17) [Subtitle]: 然後現在他已經出了他就把它黏上去了. (18) [Subtitle]: 當初《風之谷》呢就是先在動畫雜誌《Animage》上連載才做成了電影. (19) [Subtitle]: 也是在《風之谷》之後高畑勳、宮崎駿以及當時《Animage》的總編輯鈴木敏夫才共同成立了吉卜力工作室. (20) [Subtitle]: 這裡不僅能夠看到兩位大師共同創作的過程. (21) [Subtitle]: 還有上百件吉卜力珍貴的動畫手稿. (22) [Subtitle]: 見證日本「機器人與魔法少女」動畫熱潮的誕生. (23) [Subtitle]: 還有最讚的全球首度公開的經典動畫雜誌封面大型拍照場景. (24) [Subtitle]: 想要親眼看看娜烏西卡還有吉卜力的動畫世界嗎. (25) [Subtitle]: 或只是想要跟我一樣充實王蟲的收藏. (26) [Subtitle]: 即刻購票進場一起揭開吉卜力誕生的秘密吧. (27) [Slogan]: Animage雜誌和吉卜力展.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves through various parts of an indoor exhibition space. It includes areas with high ceilings and metal beams, white walls adorned with hundreds of anime posters, glass display cases with mechanical and organic-looking models, and a recreations of anime settings like the Catbus interior.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice starts with high energy and clarity, speaking at a fast pace against an upbeat electronic BGM with a strong, rhythmic synth beat. The acoustic environment is very clean with a bright spectral centroid. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effects occurs as the speaker introduces the exhibition details. The voice pitch remains varied and engaging. (3) A soft female voice briefly asks a question with a rising intonation, followed by the male host's confident and enthusiastic confirmation. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume. (4) The narration continues with historical facts about Studio Ghibli; the voice tone is professional yet animated. Percussive synth stabs in the music align with the informational flow. (5) As the call to action begins, the music swells slightly in brightness. A final subtle chime sound effect punctuates the invitation to visit the exhibition before the audio track ends cleanly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Historical Trivia -> Exhibition Highlights -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the 'Animage and Ghibli Exhibition' by sharing interesting trivia about the founding of Studio Ghibli and showcasing the unique models and manuscripts available at the event. It uses a high-energy hosting style to create excitement and encourage ticket purchases.
